sfx_review.note: Short broadband transient at ~59.0 s coincides with the CRM Suite nav click (could be a click), but similar transients recur at ~58.4 s and ~59.5 s, suggesting music percussion; CLAP whoosh score is weak (0.21) and the shape is not a sweep.

pattern.description: Cursor clicks 'CRM Suite' in the sidebar; the nav item fills orange instantly, the 'Create a Bundle' page content fades out while the 'CRM Suite' plan page fades in on top with a slight upward settle, then the cursor drifts onto the Professional card.
pattern.why_premium: The persistent sidebar anchors the viewer while only the content pane crossfades, so a page change reads as one continuous product session rather than a cut; the instant nav fill confirms the click before the content swap.

build_hint.gsap: tl.set('.nav-crm', {className: '+=active'}).set('.nav-bundle', {className: '-=active'}).to('.page-bundle', {opacity: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power1.in'}, 0.05).fromTo('.page-crm > *', {opacity: 0, y: 12}, {opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.03}, '<0.1').to('.cursor', {x: cardX, y: cardY, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power2.inOut'}, '<')
build_hint.remotion: Outgoing page opacity interpolate(frame, [1, 7], [1, 0]); incoming page opacity interpolate(frame, [3, 10], [0, 1]) and translateY interpolate(frame, [3, 12], [12, 0], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic)}); nav fill switches at the click frame; cursor path with Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic).

notes: No visible blur, only an opacity crossfade; blur_crossfade chosen as the closest catalog pattern (content-pane crossfade within a persistent shell). Camera verdict tilt_up likely reflects the incoming content's slight upward settle rather than a true camera move. Outgoing Create a Bundle page is not in the end frame so it is not listed.
